html:
Custom decorations were introduced on 30 March 2020. They can be won by participating in derbies and can be found "elsewhere" in the game. With the June 2020 update there are now 3 custom decorations. These include a Gardener's Decoration, Stonemason's Decoration, Pedestal Decoration, and Yard Decoration. You can own more than one of each custom decoration.

Alfred the postman will bring the very first custom decoration to all players reaching level 71.

Players can upgrade the Gardener's and Pedestal decorations through 5 levels and the Stonemason's and Yard decorations through 6 levels. At each level you select one of 3-4 different parts, each is offered in 3-4 different colors. You can see all of the options for each upgrade level by going back and forth, but once you’ve purchased the upgrade that you’ve configured for that level, you cannot reverse it, so choose wisely. The cost to purchase each upgrade level varies, but may include coins, vouchers, and blueprints. With 5-6 parts to each custom decoration you will have 3-4 different options to choose from at each level, and 3-4 colors to choose from for each part. Those combinations result in a staggering 330,000+ different possible custom decorations when each custom decoration is completed!

Upgrades can be purchased with a combination of coins, vouchers, and blueprints. Blueprints can be gotten from the derby, mystery boxes, the Wheel of Fortune, and the valley shop.

Upgrading

Note: You can see all upgrade paths and their cost in this page: Custom decorations/ Lists.

Pedestal Decoration

In this example, we’ll look at the Pedestal Custom Decoration as it’s upgraded through Level 5.

Level 1 - This level adds the pedestal. There are 3 types: Classic, Floral, and Rustic. Each pedestal is offered in 4 colors.

White Classic Bronze Classic Gold Classic Grey Classic
Beige Floral Yellow Floral Pink Floral Grey Floral
Brown Rustic Grey Rustic White Rustic Gold Rustic

We've selected the White Floral pedestal. Prior to confirming our customizations for level 1, we're shown a sneak peek at some of the many level 2 options. At the bottom we'll see the cost for level 1. Tapping the Confirm button locks in this level of our custom decoration.


Level 2 - This level adds the first of two types of flowers at the base of the pedestal. There are 4 types: Daisies, Pansies, Lilacs, and Tulips. Each flower is offered in 4 different colors.

Pink Daisies White Daisies Orange Daisies Blue Daisies
Beige Pansies Yellow Pansies Pink Pansies Grey Pansies
Blue Lilacs White Lilacs Purple Lilacs Pink Lilacs
Orange Tulips Red Tulips Purple Tulips White Tulips

We've selected the Pink Daisies. Prior to confirming our customizations for level 2, we're shown a sneak peek at some of the many level 3 options. At the bottom we'll see the cost for level 2. Tapping the Confirm button locks in this level of our custom decoration.


Level 3 - This level adds a border around our flower bed. There are 3 types: Stone, Floral, and Metal. Each border is offered in 3 colors.

Beige Stones Brown Stones Grey Stones
White Floral Green Floral Golden Floral
Bronze Metal Silver Metal Gold Metal

We've selected the Golden Floral border. Prior to confirming our customizations for level 3, we're shown a sneak peek at some of the many level 4 options. At the bottom we'll see the cost for level 3. Tapping the Confirm button locks in this level of our custom decoration.


Level 4 - This level adds the second of two types of flowers at the base of the pedestal. There are 4 types: Daisies, Pansies, Lilacs, and Tulips. Each flower is offered in 4 different colors.

Pink Daisies White Daisies Orange Daisies Blue Daisies
Purple Pansies Blue Pansies Yellow Pansies Red Pansies
Blue Lilacs White Lilacs Purple Lilacs Pink Lilacs
Orange Tulips Red Tulips Pink Tulips White Tulips

We've selected the Orange Daisies. Prior to confirming our customizations for level 4, we're shown a sneak peek at some of the many level 5 options. At the bottom we'll see the cost for level 4. Tapping the Confirm button locks in this level of our custom decoration.


Level 5 - This level adds the top to our pedestal. There are 3 types: Vase, Birdbath, and Monkey. Each top is offered in 4 different colors.

Red Vase Yellow Vase Purple Vase Pink Vase
Pink Birdbath Blue Birdbath Purple Birdbath Yellow Birdbath
Gold Monkey Brown Monkey Grey Monkey Dark Green Monkey

We've selected the Yellow Birdbath. Our custom decoration is complete, and cannot be upgraded further. At the bottom we'll see the cost for level 5. Tapping the Confirm button locks in this level of our custom decoration.

Decoration Types

Stonemason's Decoration
Pedestal Decoration
Yard Decoration
